purpose: Conditional return-gap and risk assessment of existing weights; not selection-strategy validation
equity_alpha_status: unvalidated; do not extrapolate historical intercept or predict score into returns
comparison: KOSPI price index; dividends, trading costs, tax and cash yield require separate assumptions
methods: Current holdings daily-return exposure and covariance only
Moving-block bootstrap for sensitivity of risk parameters, not validated future intervals
Exact buy-and-hold cash-drag and required-stock-outperformance scenarios
limitations: Latest 266-day diagnostics already observed before this protocol; this is exploratory analysis
Current selected holdings are conditioned on selection date; historical returns cannot validate stock-selection alpha
Cash policy rate is not an available or guaranteed deposit yield
Risk scaling and bootstrap do not validate return-forecast accuracy
